name: multi-value-partial-collapse
description: WRIT-345 item 5 (spec/fold.md §5.9): a later write observing only SOME of the concurrent versions, not all of them and not none. op-d causally succeeds op-a and op-b and so supersedes both, but is concurrent with op-c, which stays a maximal write in its own right -- the register partially collapses to two entries (op-d's merged value and op-c's untouched one), distinct from three-way-concurrency (no write observes any other) and observed-collapse (one write observes every concurrent version).
